packageRules.description: Group container base image digest bumps
Keep pre-commit hook versions in step with the lockfile

description: Auto-merge GitHub Actions minor/patch/digest updates. Digest is included deliberately (issue #552): the grouped Actions PR also carries digest-only members (a SHA re-pin of an unchanged tag, or a workflow `services: image:` digest bump), and Renovate disables auto-merge for the whole group when any member is not automergeable, so without digest here no grouped Actions PR could ever auto-merge

Accepted trade-off, reviewed 2026-09-05: a digest bump is a supply-chain change, so automerging it means a re-pinned SHA reaches main without a human reading the diff. Kept because the alternative is no Actions automerge at all (see above), and because the change still has to clear every required check and the merge queue before it lands: automergeType 'pr' merges only on a green branch, pinDigests keeps each action at an immutable SHA rather than a movable tag, minimumReleaseAge holds fresh releases, and slsa-github-generator is carved out below with automerge false. Revisit this if any workflow is ever granted contents: write or a release-publishing token beyond RELEASE_TOKEN's current scope.

Security updates - high priority. Datasource ids, not manager ids: the former `github-actions` entry here was a manager id and matched nothing (issue #552). The github-actions manager resolves `uses:` refs via the github-tags datasource.

Verified 2026-09-05: github-releases matches nothing in this repo today. Renovate emits it only for a `# renovate: datasource=github-releases` annotation, and the repo has none (which also leaves the first customManager below matching nothing). It is kept as a no-op so adding such an annotation later does not silently skip this rule. Note this list covers neither `npm` (frontend/package.json) nor `docker` (Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, the ghcr.io customManager); widening it changes their schedule and labels, so it is a separate decision rather than a drive-by edit.

packageRules.description: Pin GitHub Actions to commit SHA

Never SHA-pin the SLSA generator (the #378 breakage). Its reusable workflow resolves its own builder from the calling ref and rejects anything that is not refs/tags/vX.Y.Z, so a digest pin fails with 'Invalid ref' while the generator job still reports success and only the final gate turns red on exit 27. This rule must stay after the pinDigests rule above to override it; see the DO-NOT-SHA-PIN comment in .github/workflows/slsa-provenance.yml.
Python version updates - manual review required

Builder and runtime stage Python images move in lockstep, by hand: Renovate may only propose digest updates for them, never version bumps, so the two Dockerfile FROM lines cannot drift apart (issue #295; the #288 breakage)

customManagers.description: Bump digest-pinned container images embedded in workflow run steps (e.g. the nginx.conf syntax check in ci.yml)
